title: Hooks, describe & tables
summary: Group two table tests in test.describe, move the shared navigation into test.beforeEach, and check filtering (category + search) and sorting.
why: Hooks remove duplicated setup and make each test start from the same known state — the automated version of a test precondition.
objectives: test.describe('product table', …) with a test.beforeEach that opens /products
Filter: Category 'Dairy' → 'Showing 4 of 12 products'; search 'ch' → only Cheddar
Sort: click 'Price' → first row Banana, aria-sort ascending; click again → Cheddar first
hints: Data rows only: page.getByRole('row').filter({ has: page.getByRole('cell') })
pitfalls: beforeAll with a shared page couples tests — prefer beforeEach + the page fixture.
Counting rows including the header row.
teachAlong: Cause: beforeEach runs before every test in the describe.
Effect: each test is independent and can run alone or in parallel.
Gate: planted bugs break sorting and searching — your tests must notice both.

requires.reason: Group the tests with test.describe('product table', () => { … }).
Move the shared page.goto('/products') into test.beforeEach — the automated precondition.

mutants.reason: clicking a column header no longer sorts

wrongSolutions.label: duplicated setup, no hook, misses the search bug
